text:
emily: Quick heads-up — rolling out a change to our release cadence and freeze policy starting Mon 2026-03-30. TL;DR: major feature trains -> biweekly, minor/patch trains -> weekly. This is to improve canary stability and reduce mid-week firefights. New defaults and exceptions below.

chen: Does this affect canary durations? Our embeddings pipeline relies on a 30m canary right now.

emily: Yes — default canary for 'major' releases will be 120m (was 60m). Minor/patch releases default to 45m. Emergency hotpatch lane remains unchanged (30m).

rahul: If a canary starts failing near the end of the window (e.g., 1h50m), do we auto-revert or is it manual? Need clarity for oncall.

emily: Auto-fallback policy: if error rate >= 75% sustained for 5m during canary, traffic is automatically routed back to previous variant. That counts as a fallback. Full rollback requires deploy-owner approval unless the deploy has the `auto-rollback:true` flag.

deploy-bot: scheduled: canary-window-config updated for 'major' -> canary_duration=120m starting 2026-03-30T09:00:00Z

jen: Are security-only patches exempt from the biweekly major freeze?

sasha: Also, how does this impact Dedicated customers with reserved capacity? We don't want to surprise them with longer canaries eating burst.

emily: Security patches are exempt from the major freeze (they can be requested and scheduled outside the biweekly major window) but they must still pass the security gating checklist and the canary/fallback rules. For Dedicated customers: this is a process change, not a capacity change — reserved pools are unchanged. If a tenant requests shorter canary windows we can make an exception per-contract.

samir: I'll update the release checklist, runbooks, and the internal docs. Will also coordinate a short AM/EM pass with Solutions to surface any tenant concerns.

chen: Can we add a sample canary config to the runbook so engineers can copy/paste?

emily: Certainly. Example (put this in the release runbook):

```json
{
  "release_type": "major",
  "canary_duration": "120m",
  "fallback_threshold": 0.75,
  "fallback_window_mins": 5,
  "rollback": "manual unless auto-rollback flag is set"
}
```

jen: :thumbsup: Also, please coordinate a short customer-facing blurb for Dedicated partners about the policy change.

emily: Agreed — @samir please own customer comms draft and loop in marketing. I'll draft the internal announcement tomorrow.

deploy-bot: note: release-freeze-exemptions form created -> https://intranet/release-exemptions (use for security/critical fixes)

rahul: I'll run a hotpatch drill next Wed to validate the emergency lane and rollback path. Will share results here.

emily: Thanks — appreciate the quick feedback. If anyone sees gaps in the runbook or exceptions we missed, reply here or DM me. We'll reconvene post-first-major to do a retrospective. :party_popper:
